text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — I noticed a weird jump in inbound MQLs on the KPI dashboard after last week's webinar. link: https://dash.redwood-inference.com/marketing/kpis — can folks check?
Omar: saw that too, looks like two campaign UTMs with slightly different params (+utm_term). probable double-counting.
Cara: starting a quick audit on the attribution window and the ETL dedupe flow. will post findings.
Ben: if that's true, our week-over-week growth pops might be artificial ~20%. not great for the exec brief.
Priya: agree we should avoid publishing raw numbers until we confirm. suggest publishing an annotated note with adjusted figures. :memo:
Jonah: also worth checking the cohort filter on the dashboard — currently set to `last_touch`. maybe switch to `first_touch` for the brief and mark as change.
Maya: action plan: Cara confirms dedupe source + fixes ETL, Jonah toggles dashboard filter to first_touch for the public KPI view, Ben updates the weekly brief with both raw and adjusted numbers, Priya will add an annotation. target: EOD tomorrow. sound ok?
Cara: initial SQL run shows duplicate rows where `utm_campaign` and `utm_term` both present. snippet: ```sql
SELECT lead_id, COUNT(*) as hits
FROM raw.leads
WHERE created_at > '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY lead_id
HAVING hits > 1;
```
Cara: that query returns ~1,184 leads with duplicate session keys. digging into join keys now.
Omar: found ~12 signups with same company & identical utm string — likely test/regression bot. will surface IPs to blocklist.
Ben: for the webinar narrative: we should still highlight conversion quality (SQL->Closed) not just volume. I'll add a small cohort chart to show conversion rate is stable when deduped.
Priya: prepping the dashboard note: "Adjusted figures exclude duplicate UTMs + bot signups. See dataset version v2026-03-15-1." will attach to the KPI card.
Jonah: updated the dashboard to include a toggle and saved a shared view: `KPI - Public (first_touch, deduped)` — link: https://dash.redwood-inference.com/marketing/views/kpi-public
Maya: @Evan can you ping CS & Sales that the weekly numbers will be replaced with annotated numbers tomorrow morning? want to avoid the 'why did my dashboard move' pings.
Evan: pinged #cs-team and sent an FYI email to sales-ops. added note in #support: "marketing: KPI adjustment scheduled; do not distribute raw export until 3/15." :white_check_mark:
Cara: pushed a staging ETL patch that normalizes utm params and dedupes on `lead_id` + `session_id`. tests passing locally, running CI now.
Maya: excellent. If CI looks good, promote to prod after 11am deploy window.
Ben: also planning messaging iteration for next webinar cadence — A/B test two subject lines and track CTR -> registration quality. I'll include a separate sheet in the brief for that.
Priya: added an item to the weekly checklist: "verify attribution pipeline before publishing weekly KPI deck" — will update runbook.
Maya: final note for the brief: include both raw and adjusted numbers, short footnote about the dedupe + a link to the SQL query and dataset tag. goal: transparent, avoid misleading spike narratives. :sparkles:
Jonah: re-check scheduled for tomorrow 10:00am PT to confirm numbers and lock the publish.
Cara: CI green — promoting patch now. will post confirmation once prod runs complete.
Maya: thanks all. looping back after deploy.
Ben: +1
Cara: prod run finished, dedupe applied, numbers updated in `marketing.kpi_v1` dataset. raw table preserved as `marketing.kpi_raw_20260314`.
Maya: updated the weekly KPI doc with links to raw vs adjusted tables and a short note: https://drive.redwood-inference.com/marketing/kpis/weekly-2026-03-15 — please review before publish.
Priya: added the annotation on the dashboard card: "Adjusted for duplicate UTMs and bot signups (see dataset v2026-03-15-1)".
Evan: CS acknowledged the note. no end-customer impact reported.
Maya: closing loop — we'll include the adjusted frame in tomorrow's exec slide and log the postmortem in the Launch board. thanks team. :pray:
